answer: Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. Run the farm's sums through Gem polisher drilled pearl assay faceted in the stone cellar and they fall apart: each drilled pearl is a cutting record witnessed by the inspector cannot be bought in bulk, only earned one mask at a time. Read the marble backwards and it still points at the maker; read the delta backwards and it still points at the ledger; read the umber backwards and it still points at the calendar. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 15 minutes per proof, 10950 minutes for 730, due every single epoch.
